display_name: Example University research cluster (synthetic, never deployed)
notes: Synthetic: a university that does not exist, written to differ from Wayne State wherever module-schema 1 lets a module differ (Linear BEE-200), so a test that passes only for Wayne State shows itself. Nothing here was measured and no machine answers at these names: every host and link is under the reserved name university.example (RFC 2606), ssh_host_key is empty and egress.measured holds nothing. The cluster it stands for: Slurm with no QoS and an allocation account every job must name (the lab module's account), node-local $SLURM_TMPDIR that $TMPDIR also points at, a Lustre home, Singularity on the PATH with no module to load, the internet only through a proxy that the module proxy/1 sets, an Open OnDemand portal that signs in with a cookie, Duo as the second factor, no VPN, and a login node that allows 50 processes and asks clients to poll no faster than every 120 s.
